scope: offline observational-semi provenance, team synchronization, and LIGHT lower-bound diagnostic; no production policy input or modification

inputs.corpus_contract: frozen IEM Cologne Major 2026 player-round table and replay pre-state packages
inputs.main_scenario: LOSS_NO_PLANT; N = current money - actual spend + current loss reward

observational_semi_label_provenance.source_contract: cs2-demo-format/3.0 player-economies.json[].type; frozen packages report exporter cs2df 3.1.0
observational_semi_label_provenance.unit: individual player-round; rounds.json team economy is a separate majority vote with pistol-conversion override
observational_semi_label_provenance.loadout_dependency: primary/armor are not direct branches, but their prices contribute to resulting equipmentValue
observational_semi_label_provenance.interpretation: observational semi label; not ground-truth LIGHT strategic intent
observational_semi_label_provenance.roundsense_mapping: Policy V3 behavioral audit maps individual player-economies semi => LIGHT
observational_semi_label_provenance.old_audit_taxonomy_difference: The old table's pro action was the exporter type (for example semi $300), while pro class was a separate resulting-loadout/comparison class (for example no-primary low-spend => eco). The labels answer different questions.

requested_light_fields.note: row-level values are deterministically recomputed from the frozen corpus; artifact stays aggregate-only

overall.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

T.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

CT.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

NORMAL.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

POST_PISTOL.hypothesis_pattern: reserve-target compensation predicts a negative reward-vs-residual association and a weaker reward-vs-next-cash association

formulas.reserve_required: max(0, side-aware canonical bundle cost G - current loss reward B)

contract.note: No threshold is fitted; AWP is excluded from the ordinary LIGHT lower-bound target.

team_synchronization.visibility: ORACLE RESEARCH CONTEXT only; teammate exact money, purchases, residual, and transfers are unavailable to normal-player production GSI
team_synchronization.percentile_definition: within-team midrank scaled to [0,1]: bottom=0, median rank=0.5, top=1; ties receive average rank

clean_team_subset.definition: eligible subject plus all four same-team player-rounds present; exactly five players; no raw or derived drop/transfer-sensitive row in the team-round

low_spend_teammate_scenario.definition: NORMAL observational-semi subject; at least 3/4 teammates are observational eco or semi; subject money exceeds teammate median

drop_sensitive_descriptive.definition: all raw observational-semi subjects in exact five-player team-rounds with at least one raw or derived drop/transfer-sensitive row; descriptive only

low_spend_teammate_scenario.definition: NORMAL observational-semi subject; at least 3/4 teammates are observational eco or semi; subject money exceeds teammate median

definitions.strict_full_rifle_plus_armor: next actual mode FULL and resulting rifle with armor
definitions.full_buy_like: next actual mode FULL and resulting rifle or sniper with armor

definition.normal_retained_primary_top_up: NORMAL with retained primary, regardless of resulting family
definition.normal_no_primary_pistol_utility_or_armo: NORMAL with no retained primary and no resulting primary; secondary/utility/armor may change
definition.normal_new_smg_plus_armor: NORMAL with no retained primary; resulting SMG with armor
definition.normal_other_new_primary_bundle: NORMAL with no retained primary; any other resulting primary bundle
definition.post_pistol_observational_semi: POST_PISTOL observational semi; kept separate regardless of bundle
definition.overtime_other: OVERTIME observational semi; n is too small for interpretation

force_armor_invariant_audit.invariant: FORCE => armor > 0 except explicit AWP-no-armor path

hypothesis_assessment.architecture_decision: own-state future-affordability lower bound and spending envelope, with context/subtype-specific constraint sources; not one fixed cash target and not teammate-money synchronization
